cases.name: frame: chamfer an inside edge, then click its neighbour (e470c0e2)
cases.note: The chamfer's 1 mm end edge lies on the neighbour's line and shares its end, so a chain walked on the preview pulls it in; its midpoint binds the concave vertical corner edge below it.

cases.name: frame: click an edge the chamfer generated (6c2fc3ba)
cases.note: expectedSecond is empty: the test asserts only that every member is an input edge, since which input edge is nearest that pixel is the picker's call. Viewed close up, so the click is clear of the chamfered edge's own ghost line.

cases.name: hexagon: fillet one rim edge, then click the next (77f004a6)
cases.note: A bare hexagon has no tangent neighbours, so each click is exactly one edge.

cases.name: rounded hexagon: fillet the top loop, then click the bottom loop (77f004a6)
cases.note: Each click chains its whole G1 loop and nothing else.

cases.name: teardrop: fillet the top loop, then add the tip edge (55a4cca2)
cases.note: The preview's mitre edge sits on the mirror plane, exactly between two loop edges: walked into, it fails the build as an ambiguous reference.
